china_opportunities.value: Arc Raiders Is Finally Testing A PvE Mode Arc Raiders developer Embark Studios has officially announced that fans of the popular extraction shooter will soon have a more cooperative-focused way to enjoy exploring topside, as a long-awaited PvE mode will be available to test from October 13-20. The announcement comes three months after news that Embark was testing a unique PvE map condition on Chinese beta servers . This time around, though, players won't be forced to seek a specific map condition to get their PvE fix. Instead, a new toggle will be available during the week-long test, allowing the choice between standard matchmaking and the PvE mode. Solos, duos, and trios will all share the same lobbies in PvE mode, as they no longer pose any threat to each other. However, Embark has stated that some major map conditions, such as Night Raids, Hidden Bunker, Locked Gate, and Frigate, will remain only available in standard matchmaking. In a press release, Embark has clarified that there is no guarantee a permanent PvE mode will come to Arc Raiders. "It’s possible that this will not work," the release says. "This test is not a promise that there will be a PvE mode in the future, but take this as an indication that we are seriously considering it. We don’t yet know how the potential future version of this setting might look. It’s plausible that any future version could look very different from what you experience in the beta test." However, I'd be quite shocked if the new mode doesn't land well, given that a substantial portion of the player base has expressed interest in a strictly PvE option. In the press release, Embark states that 37% of players are cooperative-only raiders, meaning they actively avoid PvP encounters whenever possible. And of those players, 70% have expressed a desire for fewer hostile encounters with other raiders. Even more shockingly, 40% of PvP players say the same. All of this comes as player numbers have steadily dwindled in recent months, at least partially due to Embark's decision to turn to bi-yearly updates for Arc Raiders . The resulting content drought has been concerning over the past six months, but the addition of a PvE mode a handful of days after the game's upcoming Frozen Trail update could be the kick in the pants it needs to recapture those lovely early days . Ailing extraction shooter Marathon added PvE modes to its lineup back in July, which briefly boosted player counts. However, it has since continued struggling to maintain a significant player base in the time since. Arc Raiders' overall mainstream appeal may yet help to keep it from the same fate, but there's no doubt that a lot is riding on these upcoming changes. The Arc Raiders PvE test will run from October 13-20. Until then, you can dive into the Frozen Trail update on October 8, which will contain a smorgasbord of new quests, a fresh map to explore, extra weapon customization options, and a wide variety of quality-of-life changes. So, keep an eye on our comprehensive Arc Raiders guides hub for all of your needs when the update lands. 待确认 GameSpot / https://www.gamespot.com/articles/arc-raiders-is-finally-testing-a-pve-mode/

input.china_demand: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly! In a railway station, a punctual departure is never left to chance. In Train Station Tycoon , you take charge of a bustling railway station. Plan arrivals, assign platforms, manage connections, and coordinate your teams to ensure every train leaves on time. Because in a station, everything can go wrong in a matter of seconds. A breakdown blocks a platform. A passenger falls ill. Will you be able to keep the traffic under control? A Management Game Where Every Minute Counts Each day begins with a new transport schedule. Trains follow one another relentlessly, carrying hundreds of passengers, and must depart on time to avoid delaying subsequent lines. Your role is to: assign the right platform to each train; organize efficient connections ; avoid conflicts between schedules; maintain smooth passenger flow ; anticipate disruptions before they spread. As you progress, your station welcomes ever more trains, passengers, and unforeseen events. Rush hours become true tests where every decision matters. Satisfaction comes when everything falls into place: trains arrive, passengers find their way, and traffic remains smooth despite the pressure. From a Small Halt to a Central Hub Start with a regional stop and expand your infrastructure . Add new platforms, footbridges, elevators, or business lounges. Each upgrade alters passenger behavior, reduces congestion, and improves your station's profitability. Your Reputation Depends on Your Choices Your success is evaluated based on three criteria: train punctuality , passenger satisfaction , and your station's appeal . Should you invest in new platforms? Hire more security staff? Build a new footbridge? The choice is yours. Recruit the Right Teams A high-performing station doesn't rely solely on its infrastructure. It beats to the rhythm of the men and women who run it. Recruit and manage different departments: information desk staff; cleaning and catering teams; maintenance crew; PRM (Passengers with Reduced Mobility) assistance. No Two Days are Alike Even with perfect organization, the unexpected is inevitable. You will have to face numerous dynamic events : technical failures, sick passengers, animals on the tracks, suspicious packages, sudden crowds, and more. Each situation forces you to rethink your priorities to limit the impact on the rest of the traffic. Key Features Play solo or in coop up to 4 players. Manage a railway station welcoming trains and passengers with diverse needs. Optimize traffic flow across networks ranging from 2 to 30 tracks. Recruit and coordinate specialized teams to maintain high-quality service. Face dynamic events that disrupt your daily operations. Manage 3 different stations across 3 unique maps. Prepare for upcoming additional content featuring new countries. Passengers will only see one thing: a train departing on time. It's up to you to make sure everything else works. china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards! Probably the cutest bakery simulation game, but all these animals swear like real thugs! Join our Discord to get playtest keys, contribute, and share your feedback to help us improve: You play an undercover cop. Your target: some ex-con fresh out of prison. Your mission: work at his bakery, gather evidence, take him down. Here's the twist—your bread ends up being so good that the shop goes viral. Your police chief keeps calling, furious about your zero arrests. The thug's still there. And you're too busy managing to care. Your fortune cat tells you to "get the f--- out.", but he will also bring you more customers. You have to deal with the local seagull mobs. You have to sell some shady powder after you win your boss' trust. And you have a raccoon consultant with a mouth like Saul Goodman. Recruit and train your employees, research new recipes, expand your store, run advertisements, stock up on new baking equipment, fill the shelves with a variety of pastries and bread, and tastefully decorate your bakery. Your goal is to provide customers with unforgettable experiences every time they visit. You are recruited by a gang member who initially planned for a money-laundering operation. However, as an ambitious manager, you see the potential for this bakery to thrive. Explore the neighborhood after the store closes: talk to neighbors and customers, assist them, and unlock their stories. You might find yourself deeply involved with the community and falling in love with this charming little bakery. Attract special customers like a grumpy yet amusing old bird, or the adorable yet soulful puppies. These unique customers are not easy to lure in! Discover their preferences and cater to them. Whether it’s the right ads, the perfect bakery products, or special decorations, make them feel welcome. As a reward, they’ll display unique behaviors. input.china_demand: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. Unlock new military policies and weapons to enhance your troops' combat capabilities. Explore new areas, push the frontlines, and face stronger enemies! Build alliances, sabotage your enemies and outsmart your rival clans in a seamless blend of turn-based empire building and real-time battles. Become Shogun Experience the updated, enhanced, and complete version of the grand strategy classic; Total War: SHOGUN 2 and all of its DLC, including the Rise of the Samurai and Fall of the Samurai campaigns. Updates include: • Improved visuals, updated lighting, shadows, and textures • 1440p and 4K UI scaling • Modernised controls • New full Japanese and Chinese voice acting and text localisation • 50 + newly playable minor factions • Integrated in-game mod support using Mod.io • 64 bit upgrade, and more Grand Strategy Wage total war, unite Japan and become Shogun. Master Bushido and Chi, war and peace, build alliances, lead massive armies, construct mighty castles and execute acts of cunning subterfuge to fuel your campaigns across the entire Shogun era from the rise of the first Shogun to the fall of the last Samurai. Tactical Battles Command massed armies of samurai warriors in dramatic real-time tactical battles. Master the tactics of the Shogun era and sweep across the battlefields of Feudal Japan, commanding massive, pitched battles, besieging towering fortresses, and springing devastating ambushes. input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses. input.china_demand: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder. Track clues behind locked doors as Agent Eva , or manage the operation from analog terminals as Analyst Miles . One is in the heart of danger on the field; the other is at the desk, buried in data. You cannot see each other's screens, yet you must become each other's eyes and mind. Dual Protocol is a pure Noir asymmetric detective experience where your voice and the information you relay are your only weapons. In this investigation, the only way forward is to keep talking. You must instantly describe every complex symbol, every mysterious object, and every lock you encounter to your partner. A single miscommunication or a missing detail in the halls of the Castellari Manor could lead to the case being closed forever. The mysterious murder at the city’s most prestigious estate is too deep to be solved from a single perspective. As Eva, touch the physical evidence on the ground; as Miles, dive into the archives to decrypt technical blueprints. Eva finds the clues Miles cannot reach; Miles analyzes the complex data Eva cannot decipher. A bleak universe where the technological texture of the 90s collides with classic noir atmosphere. Search for the truth amidst CRT flickers, heavy shadows, and the tactile clatter of vintage computers. Manually enter terminal commands, scan documents, and piece together the Castellari murder bit by bit. Cross-Data Verification Connect the dots by matching real-time field info with hidden central records. Asymmetric Operation One player physically triggers mechanisms in the manor while the other reads complex system manuals to guide the way. Critical Deduction When Miles's data and Eva's observations unite, the veil of mystery over the Castellari murder will finally lift. Experience the journey of a content creator from obscurity to industry leadership! 关于这款游戏 从一名默默无闻的创作者开始，打造属于你的内容帝国。 《流量时代（Creator Era）》是一款像素风模拟经营游戏。 从零开始，你将踏入内容创作行业，选择属于自己的发展方向，拍摄视频、积累粉丝、打造爆款内容，与品牌合作、直播带货、组建团队，最终建立属于自己的传媒公司，成为影响千万人的顶级创作者。 每一次选题、每一次发布、每一次商业决策，都将改变你的创作生涯。 你，能否成为下一个时代传奇？ 🎥 从零开始创作 从一间小房间、一张桌子、一台电脑开始。 选择视频题材，策划内容，拍摄、剪辑、发布。 不同的内容方向拥有不同的发展路线。 数码 游戏 科技 汽车 美食 动画 搞笑 知识科普 Vlog 摄影 旅行 健身 美妆 宠物 音乐 更多创作领域…… 寻找热点，把握趋势，制作真正能够爆火的视频。 📈 数据决定一切 每一条视频都会实时产生数据。 观察你的： 播放量 点赞 收藏 评论 弹幕 转发 粉丝增长 热度趋势 收益变化 研究数据，调整创作方向，打造属于自己的爆款公式。 🤝 接受商业合作 《阴阳界》取材自《聊斋志异》《山海经》等经典东方志怪传说，将聂小倩、宁采臣、白蛇、青蛇、法海等耳熟能详的人物与故事融入游戏世界。 人、鬼、尸、妖四大阵营齐聚，百位魂灵自由搭配！ 组建属于你的最强魂灵军团，在诡谲阴森的东方鬼怪世界中征战阴阳两界，亲手打破既定秩序！ 🎁 核心福利：轻松养成，资源不断 七日狂欢： 登录参与七日活动，持续领取养成资源，开局快速组建阵容！ 等级豪礼： 提升等级即可解锁阶段奖励，成长一路有惊喜！ 成长之路： 完成养成目标即可领取丰厚资源，阵容成型更轻松！ 挂机收益： 离线也能持续积累资源，上线即可领取，轻松升级不爆肝！ ⚔️ 游戏特色亮点 • 中式恐怖，国潮志怪 独特厚涂暗黑美术风格，融合棺材、墓地、纸钱、地府、轮回等大量中式民俗与鬼怪元素。 从阴森场景到魂灵角色，从幽冥地府到荒野孤坟，营造诡谲压迫的东方氛围，呈现独具特色的 中式恐怖美学 。 • 四族集结，自由配队 人、鬼、尸、妖四大阵营 各具特色，不同魂灵拥有独特定位与技能机制。 根据阵营、技能、站位自由搭配阵容，弱势魂灵也能通过组合与策略发挥价值，打造属于你的专属魂灵军团！ • 放置挂机，轻松变强 离线挂机、自动战斗，资源持续积累；奇遇相伴，探索寻宝，上线即可领取成长收益。 无需长时间重复操作，也不用一直盯着战斗， 碎片时间也能养成阵容，挂机一样持续变强！ • 超多玩法，征战两界 斗法大会、锁妖塔、云游、树妖再临、除魔卫道、争夺福地、冥河渡魂、幻象塔、阴阳榜、墓穴探宝、血战之夜、群英巅峰、天命之战…… PVE、PVP、爬塔、探索、排行、资源争夺等玩法轮番开启， 不只是挂机推图，更有丰富挑战等待解锁！ • 聊斋山海，经典重现 聂小倩与宁采臣的七世姻缘，白蛇、青蛇与法海的恩怨纠葛…… 熟悉的东方传说将在这里重新展开。收集魂灵、解锁故事，在征战中重温那些流传千年的志怪传奇。 ☯️ 阴阳失衡，百鬼夜行 混沌初开，天地分阴阳。 众生皆求长生，修魂炼魄，以求魂灵不灭。人族居于阳界，亡者由黑白无常引入幽冥，经地府审判后重入六道轮回。 然而，并非所有亡魂都会接受既定命运。 有人因执念不散化为厉鬼；有人因怨气、阴煞与秘术死而不腐，脱离轮回成为尸族。尸族游走阴阳两界，以阴气修炼，甚至不断侵入阳世。 地府欲守轮回，尸族欲破生死，人族追求长生，妖族则各怀立场。 四族纷争不断，维系千年的阴阳秩序逐渐崩塌。 阴阳两界的平衡，将由你亲手打破！ 《阴阳界》开发者的话：在方寸屏幕之间，点亮属于东方的万鬼长夜 亲爱的玩家朋友们： 大家好，我们是《阴阳界》开发团队。 当我们第一次决定制作一款以中式鬼怪文化为主题的游戏时，团队内部最常讨论的问题并不是“应该做多少角色”或者“应该设置多少付费内容”，而是：在今天，我们究竟应该怎样讲述属于中国人的鬼怪故事？ 经过长时间的构思与尝试，我们最终选择以.挂机.玩法降低时间压力，以.策略.作为战斗核心，以.卡牌.承载人物与故事，再通过.RPG.式成长体验，将《聊斋志异》《山海经》和民间传说中的众多奇闻异事连接起来。我们希望打造的，不是一款只靠数值推动的产品，而是一个有人、有鬼、有尸、有妖，也有情义、因果、执念和选择的阴阳世界。 一、为什么要做一款中式鬼怪游戏 中华传统文化中的鬼怪，从来不只是为了吓人。 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 我们喜欢.灵异.故事带来的神秘感，也敬畏.聊斋.故事中复杂的人性。在设计过程中，团队查阅了许多关于.鬼怪.、.妖怪.、.僧.、.志怪.、.问道.和.蛊.文化的资料，希望角色不是披着古装的战斗单位，而是真正拥有来历、愿望和命运的人物。 为了寻找适合《阴阳界》的产品形态，我们研究过.SLG.的大局观、.RTS.的即时判断、.MMORPG.的长期成长，也讨论过.AVG.的叙事方式、.PUZ.的解谜设计、.FTG.的动作反馈、.FPS.的战斗节奏和.开放世界.的探索结构。我们还从.沙盒游戏.的自由、.益智游戏.的思考、.动作类.的爽快、.模拟.玩法的经营感、.角色扮演类.的代入感、.射击类.的反馈以及.竞速类.的节奏中吸取经验。 这些类型并不会被生硬地塞进游戏。它们更像一组帮助我们思考的坐标，使我们能够判断什么适合《阴阳界》，什么应该舍弃。无论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.武侠.、.生存.、.格斗.还是.收集.与.养成.，我们都希望大家能在这个世界中找到一个自然、清晰且不显得突兀的入口。 二、从经典传说出发，重新认识阴阳众生 《阴阳界》的世界由人、鬼、尸、妖四族共同构成。 人族并不总是正义，鬼族也并非生来邪恶；尸族可能保留生前最后的执念，妖族则可能比某些人更加重情。我们不想以简单的善恶标签概括角色，而是希望玩家通过剧情、羁绊和“文化志”，逐渐了解他们为什么站在这里，又为什么拔出手中的武器。 聂小倩与宁采臣的相逢，是爱情，也是命运的试探；青蛇、白蛇与法海之间的纠葛，则包含情感、规则和立场的冲突。这些故事中的人物会进入玩家的魂灵军团，却不会因此失去自己的性格。他们之间的情感联系将转化为羁绊效果，让剧情关系与战斗策略真正结合。 在寻找叙事方向时，我们参考过.新怪谈.的现代讲述方式，也研究了.密室.、.盗墓.和.剧情解谜.常用的悬念结构。我们希望某些故事拥有.灵魂与追求.般的情感余韵，也希望部分.王者荣耀.篇章呈现.双影.交错、.split.分支和.双影奇境.般真假难辨的氛围。 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 这些类型并不会被生硬地塞进游戏。它们更像一组帮助我们思考的坐标，使我们能够判断什么适合《阴阳界》，什么应该舍弃。无论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.武侠.、.生存.、.格斗.还是.收集.与.养成.，我们都希望大家能在这个世界中找到一个自然、清晰且不显得突兀的入口。 二、从经典传说出发，重新认识阴阳众生 《阴阳界》的世界由人、鬼、尸、妖四族共同构成。 人族并不总是正义，鬼族也并非生来邪恶；尸族可能保留生前最后的执念，妖族则可能比某些人更加重情。我们不想以简单的善恶标签概括角色，而是希望玩家通过剧情、羁绊和“文化志”，逐渐了解他们为什么站在这里，又为什么拔出手中的武器。 我们也研究过.张让.、.张角.、.张宝.、.张梁.、.张举.、.张济.、.张邈.、.张昭.、.张鲁.、.张南.、.张松.、.张翼.、.张任.、.刘辩.、.刘协.、.刘表.、.刘禅.、.刘封.、.孙坚.、.曹操.、.曹仁.、.曹洪.、.曹休.、.李肃.、.杨修.、.马腾.、.马岱.、.马忠.、.马融.和.韩当.等角色的历史背景。 包括.鲜卑.、.乌桓.、.羌.、.山越.和.南蛮.在内的不同族群资料，也提醒我们：构建文化图鉴时，必须避免用单一视角把复杂历史简化成刻板标签。 这些三国人物不会直接成为《阴阳界》的主角，但研究成熟历史角色如何被大众记忆，能够帮助我们塑造聂小倩、宁采臣、白蛇、青蛇、法海、钟馗、黑白无常和其他传统人物。我们希望多年以后，玩家回忆《阴阳界》时，首先想起的不是某个战力数字，而是一个真正打动过自己的角色。 input.china_demand: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern. Animated reconstructions of classic wars Historical War: The Animation is not a real-time strategy game and not a sandbox wargame. It is a library of war films: famous campaigns reconstructed as short, playable records with play, pause, replay, and a scrubbable timeline. Napoleon is the dividing line. His campaigns and everything after are Modern Wars; everything earlier is Ancient Wars. Each film is about five minutes—long enough to follow the main axis of a battle, short enough to finish in one sitting. What you get Animated maps of advances, encirclements, retreats, and naval or air contact A timeline keyed to historical beats, with campaign notes Units that move along operational lines instead of appearing from nowhere Chinese and English interface, switchable at any time Ancient Wars Alexander the Great, the Punic Wars, Cannae, the Qin unification of China, Gaixia and Han Xin’s ten-sided ambush, Caesar, the Crusades, and the Mongol conquests. Modern Wars The Napoleonic wars, Trafalgar, Tsushima, Jutland, the 1940 campaign in France, the Battle of Britain, the Eastern Front 1941–1945, the Pacific War, Midway, the Bismarck Sea, the Atlantic wolfpacks, Guadalcanal, Big Week, Nianzhuang in the Huaihai Campaign, and the 1991 Gulf War. Who it is for Anyone who wants to see how a classic campaign actually unfolded on the map—history viewers and documentary-style war animation, not unit-command gameplay.
